macos_budget_basis: Each group's budget is measured wall time plus headroom, from run 36051245663 (macos-14, 3 vCPU, warm dependency cache) where the groups were root-lib, root-suites (sessions, journeys, transport), runtime-storage and contracts-dashboard-api: root-lib 21.7 compile + 4.3 tests; root-sessions 25.9 + 4.1; root-journeys 7.4 + 4.1 against the sessions tree; root-transport 18.2 + 12.6 against the journeys tree (test-transport re-resolves 31 workspace crates); root-dashboard-api 24.4 + 0.8 as a lone `-p tracedecay` resolution (108 dependency units and 48 workspace crates apart from every other root partition); runtime 38.8 + 5.2 and core-storage 15.3 + 2.8 with 213 dependency units missing the root cache; core-contracts 20.6 + 12.3 (one hung test, 33 s on Linux). Groups now pair partitions that share one resolution so a group compiles one chain, and the lower group carries its own dependency cache.
